about: compiler/check/summary: canonical cross-package check and lower summaries, digests, verification, rendering, and extraction invariants.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-verify-skips-check-digest
mutants.rule: VerifyAssumptions refuses any dependency whose CheckDigest disagrees with the header assumption.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-verify-skips-lower-digest
mutants.rule: VerifyAssumptions refuses any dependency whose LowerDigest disagrees with a non-zero lowering assumption.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-verify-skips-missing-import

mutants.rule: VerifyAssumptions refuses when an import recorded in the header has no resolved dependency assumption.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-object-lookup-ignores-pkg
mutants.rule: Cross-package object lookup scopes resolution by both ImportPath and NamePath.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-type-named-drops-name
mutants.from:
let tname = store.TypeNameText(s, store.ArgOf(s, t))
		return InternNamed(p, InternSym(syms, org.SelfPath), InternSym(syms, tname))
mutants.rule: Named local types preserve their canonical TypeNameText rather than colliding on index.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-row-unsorted
mutants.rule: Canonical type rows sort members by canonical key rather than written or pool order.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-codec-skips-check-digest-verify
mutants.rule: decodeCheckSection rejects any payload whose SHA-256 checksum disagrees with the header CheckDigest.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-codec-skips-lower-digest-verify
mutants.rule: decodeLowerSection rejects any payload whose SHA-256 checksum disagrees with the header LowerDigest.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-render-drops-implements

mutants.rule: Rendered package interface includes type implements claims deterministically.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-extract-leaks-unexported
mutants.rule: Unexported declarations and struct fields are omitted from CheckSection and rendered output.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-extract-skips-generic-body
mutants.rule: Generic function bodies are included in CheckSection as position-free tokens so body edits move CheckDigest.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-extract-keeps-nongeneric-body
mutants.rule: Non-generic function bodies are excluded from CheckSection so body edits preserve CheckDigest.

mutants.name: pkg-summary-extract-includes-doc-comments
mutants.rule: Regular doc and line comments are excluded from digests so position and comment edits preserve digests.
